assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a production transparent PNG sprite atlas for a Korean toddler vocabulary app. EXACT regular 6 columns by 5 rows, 30 equal square cells, canvas ratio 6:5. Each cell contains ONE photographic lifelike cutout animal centered with a thick clean white die-cut sticker outline. Entire background truly transparent. No grid lines, no text, no letters, no decorations, no ground. Keep each subject within central 76% of its cell, absolutely no overlap across cells. Friendly real animals, natural accurate anatomy and photo textures, full bodies when appropriate, consistent soft studio lighting. In strict left-to-right row order: row1 dog, cat, rabbit, bear, lion, tiger; row2 elephant, giraffe, zebra, monkey, panda, koala; row3 cow, pig, horse, sheep, goat, deer; row4 squirrel, fox, wolf, hippopotamus, rhinoceros, kangaroo; row5 penguin, duck, chicken, owl, turtle, dolphin. All exactly thirty different animals, no omissions or additions. High resolution.
